# Crestone Roofing Knoxville

> Crestone Roofing is a family roofing company. It repairs and replaces roofs on homes, businesses and churches in Knoxville, Tennessee, and across East Tennessee: Knox, Blount, Loudon, Anderson, Roane, Sevier, Jefferson, Hamblen, Grainger, Union, Monroe and Cocke counties. The work covers free roof inspections, roof repair, storm and leak repair with help on insurance claims, roof replacement, metal roofing, siding, windows and doors, gutters, and decks and covered patios. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. 24-hour emergency service available. Call (865) 830-8126.
